Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 07:15:00 -0700
Subject: QuantFlow — stage confirmation + risk & save-plan

Sanjay —

Quick check this morning on the QuantFlow opportunity (QF-2027-118). Finance is doing a mid-week commit sweep and needs a clear stage + risk classification for the forecast. Can you confirm:

- Current internal stage you have this at (e.g., Contracting / Legal / Procurement)
- Whether you expect a signed PO/SOW by end of month (yes/no/unknown)
- Any blockers on procurement or legal we should be aware of

If it helps, we can loop procurement directly or share a short save-plan template to keep this on the radar. We want to flag anything red/yellow so the forecast team can adjust probabilities.

Thanks — short replies welcome.

Priyom
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
pri...@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0147

From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@quantflow.com>

Cc: procurement@quantflow.com
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QuantFlow — stage confirmation + risk & save-plan

Hey Priyom —

Thanks for the ping. Short answers:

- Stage: Procurement review (internal procurement lead is finalizing vendor assessment).
- Signed PO by EoM: leaning no; procurement has a month-long vendor assessment to finish, so earliest is mid-September unless we accelerate.
- Blockers: procurement asked for an updated SOC2 artifacts set and a clarification on data retention for a subset of logs. Legal also wanted more detail on indemnity language in the SOW.

I attached the procurement timeline I shared internally (procurement_timeline.pdf) — shows current cadence. For now I would flag this as YELLOW: still alive but timing is slipping. I can try to pull procurement in to a call this week if that helps.

--
Sanjay Patel
CTO, QuantFlow
sanjay@quantflow.com

Thanks for the update, Sanjay — appreciate the clarity.

Per finance guidance: mark this as YELLOW in the forecast for now (probability 40-50%). Priyom, please run the quick save-plan play:

1) Fill the attached save_plan_template.xlsx with owners, mitigation steps, and dates (who's enabling procurement, required artifacts, escalation path).
2) Offer a one-call procurement Q&A this week to remove ambiguity on SOC2 and indemnity language.
3) If procurement confirms >60% probability after the call, we'll move to commit for the month. Otherwise finance will reduce commit.

Laura — any guidance on probability threshold you want us to use for the mid-week sweep? Also copying Priyom to take the lead on scheduling.

Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 09:00:00 -0700

Team —

Thanks for the quick triage. For forecasting: classify as YELLOW with a 40% commit probability and move QF-2027-118 to the `At-Risk` bucket for the weekly rollup. We need the following by EOD tomorrow to avoid auto-decommit:

- Completed save_plan_template.xlsx with owners and mitigation dates (this lives in the forecast intake folder)
- Confirmed date for procurement call (if scheduled) and a note on expected decision window
- Any material redlines in SOW that would impact ARR timing or revenue recognition (legal/indemnity items are critical)

If we don't have those items, finance will reduce the commit line for the week and adjust the mid-month projection. Priyom/aditya, please own the save-plan and include a short exec summary (2–3 bullets) for the finance deck.

Laura
Director, Revenue Finance
laura_bennett@redwood.com
